items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: The name 'Frog' appears exclusively in the [INTERVIEWER] turns (e.g., 'Frog, when you started...', 'Let me ask Frog about something'). The [INTERVIEWEE] (Chester Jones) never mentions 'Frog' by name, nor does he respond to questions directed at 'Frog' as if he were Frog. The interviewer seems to be

ctx.x: Well the only thing I can say about that, Bill, is I had a chance to use one of the sock cymbals that they used during those days. It was a low-low cymbal. I said about this high up, what you would say, about a foot high. And the guys used to use that, but they never had a chance to use it. The two of those didn't work the stick on it at all? No, no, no, they didn't work the stick on it at all.
Frog, when you started, did you have a sock cymbal too in your outfit?
